scenes.headline: How many contracts? Three numbers.
scenes.say: How many contracts should you trade? You only need three numbers.

scenes.title: 1. How much you can lose
scenes.say: One: how much you can lose. One percent of fifty thousand dollars is five hundred.

scenes.title: 2. What one contract risks
head: Contract
$ per point
4-point stop
scenes.say: Two: what one contract loses at your stop. Four points is twenty dollars on the micro, two hundred on the E-mini.

scenes.title: 3. Divide
head: Contracts
scenes.say: Three: divide. Twenty-five micros, or two E-minis. Always round down.

scenes.text: Follow for one trading concept a day.
scenes.say: Save this, and follow for one trading concept a day.

post.instagram:
1) Max loss: 1% of $50,000 = $500. 2) Risk per contract: a 4-point stop is $20 on the Micro E-mini S&P ($5/point) and $200 on the E-mini ($50/point). 3) Divide and round down: 25 micros or 2 E-minis.
